purpose: 163 remaining unapproved editorial lesson outlines plus 45 checked catalog lessons. No planned lesson unlocks before Qurʾān/Sunnah content and voice review.

sourceOrder: exact Qurʾān Arabic and referenced verse
authentic Sunnah with identifiable source and number
verified early scholarly explanation for nuanced fiqh and ʿaqīdah
safety.verification: No proposed topic contains an assigned Qurʾān verse, hadith, legal ruling, quote or audio file until independently verified. A Qurʾān excerpt must be explicitly marked; audio Qurʾān uses real recitation, never a voice clone.
safety.age4to5: One concrete situation, short simple German, gentle learning, never takfīr, hellfire threats, graphic or distressing imagery, no role pressure, no forced fasting. Safe physical and emotional boundaries.
safety.age6to8: Structured clear stories, distinct learning outcomes, supportive feedback, individual pace; explain meanings and historical context without asserting unsupported details.
safety.age9to10: Source traceability, simple comparative reflection, nuanced fiqh only with qualified source review, distinction between general rulings and individuals if ever appropriate; no independent religious judgments on persons.
safety.pictures: No portrayal of Prophets or sacred characters; original illustrations must be age appropriate and human safe.
safety.voice: Serhat Abu Malik master voice only, model eleven_v4, kids_story profile, exact text cache, no generation without explicit credit confirmation, no staging clip playback for regular children.
safety.profiles: Planning must not change school-progress-v11, daily unlocks, persisted child state, native app bundle identity or released teacher content.

progression: Mix one topic per strand per round, preserving the 38 existing lesson positions. After an authentic source review, an editorial outline can be authored and released in a separate guarded PR; the roadmap itself never unlocks a child lesson.
